topics.purpose: Define immutable build-time snapshot of identity/reference/alias/ownership registries for reproducible validation, diff and tooling.

semantics.identity_rule: Each registry snapshot has an explicit identity.
semantics.reproducibility_rule: Same source-set/format/profile yields semantically equivalent registry snapshot.
semantics.cache_rule: Snapshot cache is invalidated when source-set/format changes.
semantics.authority_rule: Snapshot is derived evidence, not canonical definition.

invariants.rule: Contract Format bootstrap authority, canonical contract sources, generated projections, historical artifacts and runtime state remain separate identities/roles; no file becomes authoritative merely by name, path order, timestamp or discovery order.
Candidate canonical changes remain inert until exact format validation, identity/reference resolution, semantic diff, applicable governance/authorization and repository acceptance succeed.

hard_gates.condition: stale snapshot used after source change
